title: Inflation of a thick neo-Hookean cylinder by a follower pressure (plane strain)
source: Finite inflation of an incompressible neo-Hookean thick-walled tube in plane strain: r² = R² + a² − A², σ_θ − σ_r = μ (λ² − λ⁻²) with λ = r/R, integrated through the wall: p = (μ/2)[(ln λ_a² − λ_a⁻²) − (ln λ_b² − λ_b⁻²)] (R. S. Rivlin, Large elastic deformations of isotropic materials VI, Phil. Trans. R. Soc. A 242:173–195, 1949; R. W. Ogden, Non-Linear Elastic Deformations, Dover 1997, §5.3.2)

quantities.quantity: radial displacement of the bore (10, 0, 0) at the pressure that inflates it to a = 15
quantities.reason: the closed form is incompressible and our material nearly so (κ/μ = 1000, a volume change of order p/κ ≈ 4·10⁻⁴); hybrid hex20, 6 × 16, follow the wall's strain gradient well inside

quantities.quantity: radial displacement of the outer wall (20, 0, 0)
